_comment: Per-category and per-type firmware annotations. Independent of all_effects.json (which is the raw RE capture, captured against GX-10 firmware 1.00 where all effects are present). Hosts that ship a unified GX-10/GX-100 dictionary use this to filter the visible effect list at runtime based on the connected device's Identity-Reply software-version. Source / confidence notes are in docs/firmware_versions.md.

GX-100.available_since_v2: 2.00 (Sept 2024 — adds 7 effects + 9 amps to close the gap with GX-10)

_keys: Category names below match the `name` field in all_effects.json (the short forms — OD, DIST, AMP, AMP_BASS, A_WAH, FB, …), NOT the long names in per_effect_types.json (OVERDRIVE, DISTORTION, AIRD PREAMP, …). The mapping between the two was confirmed empirically in May 2026.

A_WAH.source: BOSS GX-100 v2.0 announcement ("Auto Wah"). Distinct from T_WAH (Touch Wah) — they are separate categories in per_effect_types.json.

FB.source: BOSS GX-100 v2.0 announcement ("Feedbacker"); short-name FB confirmed in all_effects.json page 1 idx 16.

type_overrides._comment: Per-type firmware annotations. Each block keys by the short category name (matching `name` in all_effects.json), then by type_index (the value the device's TYPE byte selects). type_index ↔ type_name mapping comes from per_effect_types.json.

8.source: BOSS GX-100 v2.0 announcement ("SD-1 Super Overdrive")

20.source: BOSS GX-100 v2.0 announcement (3 high-gain guitar amps)

3.source: BOSS GX-100 v2.0 announcement (6 new bass amps)

_provenance.v2.0_effect_list_source: BOSS GX-100 v2.0 announcement, cross-referenced with Sweetwater + Guitar World coverage 2024-09
_provenance.type_index_source: catalogs/per_effect_types.json (this repo) cross-referenced with the BTS catalog category names in catalogs/bts_effect_catalog_complete.json
